work_outcome_context_from_existing_repor.scope: Training mechanism and work gain are distinct; endpoint arithmetic is audited separately in the main report.

limitations: One shared initialization and two updates per arm; six evaluation situations with two repeats are not twelve independent tasks.
D0 is the same-data credit isolation; second-window signals also reflect distinct policies, sampled trajectories and separately learned critics.
Decision and action counts are not gradient-contribution percentages or action-causal credit.
Zero RTG targets gave negative advantages against positive critics after handoff in the second RTG window.
The random realized member-token denominator makes distinct surrogates; unbiased-gradient equivalence is not claimed.
No actual negative terminal correction occurred in these 18 episodes; signed reconciliation remains a CPU mechanism control.
GPU sharing differed between arms; training runtime difference is not credit-method efficiency.
No ID-VTDO weighting or independent external transfer evaluation was run.
